status: Concept art, not in-game captures. Runtime models implement initial distinct silhouettes, not final concept-level detail.
style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: BARD game legendary weapon production concept. Create one polished AAA dark-fantasy-meets-lived-in-Earth concept plate. BARD identity: restrained warm gold and ink-black, elegant small serif typography, objects with history, handcraft, chipped finishes, repair marks, believable weight, musical and ritual undertones. Realistic materials, deliberately imperfect; not shiny plastic, not toy-like, not a sticker, no thick graphic border. One LARGE complete weapon only, three-quarter side view pointing right, generous negative space, no cropped ends, no hands or people. Graphite-black studio background with extremely faint warm parchment grain, soft cinematic rim light and fill showing all shapes. Subtle tiny BARD title at top left. Exact weapon name at lower left and small text 'CONCEPT • NOT IN-GAME CAPTURE' at lower right. No stats, diagrams, construction instructions, ammunition internals or real-world brands. Prioritize a distinctive readable silhouette and clear separated material masses over micro-greebles. Weapon is a fantastical game prop, not a real-world blueprint.

weapons.name: Sunbreak Testament
weapons.design: A long asymmetrical lighthouse rifle: crescent-shaped hollow brass shoulder stock, straight slim barrel sheltered by THREE stepped lighthouse buttresses, a broad sunrise fan sight, worn ivory grips. Strong long horizontal silhouette with a crescent cutout at rear. Radiance school, warm gold light.

weapons.name: Black Tide
weapons.design: A fictional harpoon-like scout rifle carved from salt-black driftwood, a deep hooked whale-tail shoulder stock, single long angular steel prow emitter, knotted rope bindings and small blue-green sea glass. Sleek downward-hooked silhouette, no generic assault-rifle receiver. Shadow school, inky violet glints.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Fog Mother of the Golden Gate. Small corroded red-orange bridge-cable ties, ghostly sea glass, drowned spectral cloth.

weapons.name: Stormglass Repeater
weapons.design: A storm-powered tuning-fork repeater with TWO very long parallel open metal prongs, an exposed luminous cyan glass bridge suspended BETWEEN them, compact ring-shaped rear grip and battered blue ceramic insulators. Stark forked negative-space silhouette. Storm school.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Stormwarden gunship over the cliffs. Add storm-grey swept fin edges and paired cyan engine-like resonance chambers.

weapons.name: Widow’s Meridian
weapons.design: A very long clockmaker rifle with a slim off-center brass spine, THREE exposed circular clockwork discs decreasing in size toward its needle-thin muzzle, a teardrop ebony shoulder rest and trailing short mourning ribbon. Side profile defined by stacked clock discs rather than a tactical receiver. Chrono school, lavender.

weapons.name: Orchard of Ashes
weapons.design: An organic rifle grown from one heavily charred twisting branch, upward split-branch fork at front cradling an ember-red seed pod, smooth polished burl shoulder stock with a distinctive root curl, blackened iron bands. Asymmetrical branch silhouette, no modern tactical parts. Primal school.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Cinder Colossus, an abandoned ash-plains war machine with a molten core. Incorporate scorched orange vent ribs into the organic wood.

weapons.name: Pilgrim’s Last Light
weapons.design: A travelling healer's folded shrine-rifle: long cream ceramic rectangular reliquary with THREE little warm light windows, aged brass carrying arch high above, leather-wrapped slender grip, a gently curved shepherd-hook butt. Mint glass at front; repair stitches on travelling leather. Restoration school. Distinct arched top silhouette.

weapons.name: Event Horizon
weapons.design: A long-range black gravity projector, not a conventional rifle: giant near-circular tilted obsidian halo at front, empty black center, narrow long graphite spine into a forked tail stock, a single gold index line and tiny violet seams. Huge ring versus thin rear silhouette. Void school. Restraint, no greeble clutter.

weapons.name: Copper Saint
weapons.design: A compact defensive firearm built behind a broad pointed copper kite-shield at front, small horizontal aperture, squared walnut rear support, leather palm grip, hammered rivets and hand-engraved names. Broad shield-forward silhouette, practical and worn. Warding school, verdigris.

weapons.name: Moth King’s Lantern
weapons.design: A handheld arcane launcher shaped like an antique lantern suspended inside TWO tall moth-wing metal arches, short rear handle, luminous dusty-violet pearl inside pierced brass cage, black silk tassel. Tall butterfly-wing silhouette, NOT a rifle wearing wings. Umbral school.

weapons.name: Choir of Thorns
weapons.design: A two-handed spellcaster made of THREE interlocking thornwood hoops that form an open curved horn around a suspended green seed crystal; crooked wooden handle and wrapped rear handhold; little bronze chime teeth. A hollow curling thorn crown silhouette, no gun body or barrel. Blight school.

weapons.name: Dawn Engine
weapons.design: An arcane accelerator resembling a handheld sunwheel: one large vertical radial brass wheel at front, scalloped sun rays, narrow horizontal lever grip and short asymmetric counterweight at rear, scratched ochre enamel. Wheel dominates profile, visible empty spokes. Dawn school, peach-gold light.

weapons.name: Winter Debt
weapons.design: A glacial trident spellcaster with THREE unequal long icy prongs projecting horizontally, silver binding yoke around dark frozen central gem, angular white-birch rear handhold, thin dangling ledger tags. Very long jagged icicle silhouette, no rifle housing. Chrono school, pale cyan.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Lumen Leviathan, a luminous crystal serpent from the Deep. Prongs resemble its uneven crystalline teeth, etched with resonance grooves.

weapons.name: Cathedral of Sparks
weapons.design: A portable thunder organ weapon: FIVE upright oxidized brass organ pipes at different heights on a compact ebony soundbox, two-handed grips, blue ceramic resonance nodes, tiny cathedral tracery. Wide upright organ-pipe silhouette, not a conventional gun. Storm school.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Stormwarden gunship. Organ pipes are repurposed storm-grey engine pods with small swept metal fins.

weapons.name: Gravesong Resonator
weapons.design: A macabre acoustic spellcaster: TWO long curving bone-white tuning tines joined to a black oval resonator, short dark wrapped handle, three little pewter bells hanging inside the opening. An elongated U-shaped fork with a hollow oval at rear, asymmetrical carved burial marks. Shadow school, muted lilac.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Fog Mother. Tuning tines subtly echo suspension-bridge arches; drowned mourning-cloth wrapping and spectral pewter bells.

weapons.name: Hearth of the Exile
weapons.design: A compact travelling hearth weapon, a squat faceted bronze brazier with an arched protective handle above, THREE low chimney vents, green warm flame behind amber windows, leather two-hand braces. Strong lantern-pot silhouette, homely worn craft, no rifle parts. Restoration school.

weapons.name: Gargantua’s Whisper
weapons.design: An alien ritual focus: one massive split obsidian crescent holds a floating rough black island-stone in its empty center, thin inverted brass crescent grip beneath, TWO short uneven antenna-like stone slivers behind. Minimal sculptural crescent silhouette, tiny violet gravitational arcs. Void school.

weapons.name: Wildfire Canticle
weapons.design: An incendiary musical hybrid weapon built like a short brass horn with a VERY wide flared bell, spiral copper tube coil around a black ceramic furnace, long worn wood palm grip, red heat scars. Bell-and-coil silhouette unmistakably different from all rifles. Primal school.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Cinder Colossus. The horn surrounds a salvaged molten-orange reactor core and visibly heat-blued vent plates.

weapons.name: Oathkeeper Lattice
weapons.design: A ward-projecting crystalline lattice weapon: open elongated diamond frame with crisscross silver bars, turquoise panes in only some cells, compact leather double-hand grip at one end, four angular corner prongs. Rectilinear transparent kite silhouette with negative space. Warding school.

weapons.name: Hollow Crown
weapons.design: An umbral crown-launcher: FIVE tall broken black-metal crown points forming a wide open semicircle around a hollow violet ring, compact short handle below and rear brace, one small cracked gold king's seal. Regal jagged fan silhouette, no rifle chassis. Umbral school.

weapons.name: First Morning
weapons.design: A radiant prism projector: THREE nested fan-shaped ivory-and-gold sunrise vanes spread around a thick triangular glass prism, long gracefully curved gold lower grip, asymmetrical small rear counterweight. Layered fan and triangular prism silhouette. Radiance school, champagne light.
weapons.bossArt: Associated boss: the Lumen Leviathan, a luminous crystal serpent from the Deep. Include a faceted serpent-eye prism and ivory crest shapes.
